items.example: She's always a shoulder to cry on.
items.mnemonic: Она всегда плечо для слёз — плачь в шубу: shoulder to cry on.

items.idiom: cross that bridge when you come to it
items.example: Let's cross that bridge when we come to it.
items.mnemonic: Решим, когда дойдём, — доиграем в бридж: cross that bridge.
